title: An inscription on a fallen pillar
description: The script flickers as if alive. Untranslated, it watches you.

onPass.narration: The pillar dissolves, revealing a vault. Gold and a glimmer of insight.

onFail.narration: The script burns your eyes; you stagger back.

choices.text: Set a warding prayer against it.

onPass.narration: Someone in your company still remembers the old words. The malice thins like smoke and the pillar yields its secrets.

onFail.narration: The words come out crooked. The script drinks them and gives nothing back.
